about: Check-in chat replies for check-chat-reminders.mjs (a made-up student). Regenerate with --refresh rather than edit.

bank account.ask: Yes, can you remind me to open a bank account?
bank account.reply: You can add {{task: Open a bank account}} to your checklist.

two things.ask: Yes please, opening a bank account and getting a bus pass
two things.reply: You can add that to your checklist here. {{task: Open a bank account}}

add it for me.ask: Yes, add it for me please
add it for me.reply: Only you can add it by tapping the card. Have you had a chance to look at [[Chess]] or [[Computing]] for your course and interests?

already there.ask: Yes, can you remind me to register with a GP?
already there.reply: That's already on your [[Checklist]], so you can tick it off there once it's done.

worried.ask: I’m really worried about money, I can’t afford food this week
worried.reply:
I am really sorry to hear you are struggling with money and food this week. 

[[Cost of Living]] and [[Food Pantry]] can help with food and money worries.

conversation.reply: Unpacking can take a while, so make sure you take some breaks. Since you're into chess and gigs, you might like [[Chess]] or [[Gigs]].
Yes, [[Chess]] is a great one for playing and meeting others who enjoy the game.
NSU's [[Gigs]] page has what's on for live music.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else you would like reminding about while you settle in, such as opening a bank account?
That is no problem at all. If anything comes up later, just let me know.
And you, have a great evening.
